title: Using Copilot and chat assistants to explain, not answer

objectives.text: Ask an AI assistant to explain an error or a piece of code without asking for the finished solution
Check an assistant's explanation against the official documentation or by running the code
Record what the assistant produced and what you verified yourself

minutes.basis: Measured on 2026-10-16. modeledP50 is the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py result for the current artifact.html bytes. modeledWorstPath adds 3.00 minutes for six wrong graded attempts (two in each of three activities, at 0.5 minutes each) before formative explanations. Successful learner inputs remain private, so qa-paths.json commits negative regressions only. aboutLabel and budget remain within the 15-minute ceiling; optional hints, anecdote, challenge, cheat sheet and sources are data-section-skip and excluded.
